spec2def(dxtn.dll dxtn.spec)

# dxtn.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dxtn-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(dxtn_shims OBJECT txc_compress_dxtn.c txc_fetch_dxtn.c)
target_link_libraries(dxtn_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32)
add_cargo_module(dxtn dxtn-cargo dxtn.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dxtn_shims)
